memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports managing coffee estate duties, walks 2 km daily, no difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin, ferrous sulfate, escitalopram). Polypharmacy – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: denies low mood, reports occasional worry about work; GAD-7 score 8 (mild anxiety).
carers: mother, Mrs Lakshmi Kumar.
goal: "I want to stay healthy enough to run the estate and support my family."

cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5, stable.

carers: mother, Mrs Lakshmi Kumar.
goal: "I wish to feel less anxious and have more energy for work."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling restless at night, mind racing about estate finances. Hard to concentrate during morning meetings. Worry interferes with sleep; taking escitalopram helps a bit but not enough.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: still able to oversee estate, notes mild fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5, unchanged.
falls: no falls, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin, ferrous sulfate, escitalopram, buspirone). Polypharmacy – schedule medication review.
mood: reports persistent anxiety, GAD‑7 14 (moderate‑severe). Denies panic attacks.
carers: mother, Mrs Lakshmi Kumar.
goal: "I want to sleep better and feel calm during the day."

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for dilated fundus exam with Dr. S. Rao at Narayana Nethralaya on 2027-03-01. Patient to bring recent glucose log.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dilated fundus exam: mild microaneurysms temporal to fovea OD, none OS. No macular edema. Visual acuity 20/20 both eyes. Recommend annual retinal screening.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: continues estate work, walks 3 km daily without fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5, stable; annual screen negative.
falls: no falls in past year, gait firm, timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin, ferrous sulfate, escitalopram, buspirone). Polypharmacy – medication review pending.
mood: reports improved sleep, GAD‑7 7 (mild anxiety). Denies depressive symptoms.
carers: mother, Mrs Lakshmi Kumar.
goal: "I want to keep my health steady so I can expand the estate next year."
